rules.rule_text:
title: MacOS Network Service Scanning
id: 84bae5d4-b518-4ae0-b331-6d4afd34d00f
status: test
description: Detects enumeration of local or remote network services.
references:
- https://github.com/redcanaryco/atomic-red-team/blob/f339e7da7d05f6057fdfcdd3742bfcf365fee2a9/atomics/T1046/T1046.md
author: Alejandro Ortuno, oscd.community
date: 2020-10-21
modified: 2026-10-19
tags:
- attack.discovery
- attack.t1046
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: macos
detection:
  selection_netcat:
    Image|endswith:
    - /nc
    - /netcat
  selection_other:
    Image|endswith:
    - /nmap
    - /telnet
  filter_main_nc_listen:
    CommandLine|re: \s(?:--listen\b|-[46DdknrtuUvz]{0,10}l[46DdknrtuUvz]{0,10})
  condition: (selection_netcat and not 1 of filter_main_nc_*) or selection_other
falsepositives:
- Legitimate administration activities
level: low
